name: session-memory
description: Mines every session for decisions, rules, root causes and gotchas, and files them in a topic tree per repo group, each item with the session quotes it came from

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that extracts and files memory items

dailyCalls.title: Model calls per day
dailyCalls.description: Cap on extract and split calls per day; past it, work waits for the next day

sweepMax.title: Transcripts per sweep
sweepMax.description: How many unfinished transcripts a new session picks up in the background

autoGroups.title: Auto groups
autoGroups.description: File a git repo no rule covers into a group with one model call

jevKey.title: OpenRouter key for recall nudges
jevKey.description: Key for Jev (OpenRouter /v1/systemone), which judges whether a matched memory item fits the conversation. Empty turns nudges off

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: Jev model id for the nudge judge

nudgeMin.title: Nudge threshold
nudgeMin.description: Jev YES probability at or above which the agent is told to call memory_search
